verdict.rationale: Cloudflare explicitly claims that DDoS protection and WAF are built into the network Workers run on and apply to every request from day one, which matches the story's 'by default, every request' requirement. The only support is a single marketing line. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on which WAF rules/managed rulesets apply by default to Worker routes, independent or hands-on corroboration of default DDoS/WAF coverage for Workers traffic.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can have DDoS protection and a web application firewall applied to every request by default

citations.quote: DDoS protection, WAF, bot management, and Zero Trust controls are built into the network and run on every request from day one.
